title: Repeating IDs
description: Sum IDs from ranges that have repeating digit patterns.
writeup:
## Approach

Given ranges of numeric IDs, find numbers whose digit string has a repeating pattern.

## Part 1

Check if the string can be split into two identical halves (e.g. `1234` → `12|34` where `12 == 34`). Only even-length numbers can match.

## Part 2

Check if the entire string is a repetition of some shorter substring. Try all divisor lengths `j` of the string length: if `s == s[:j] * (n/j)`, it's a repeating pattern. Break on the first match to avoid double-counting.
